tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Parents are suing OpenAI, according to Times Now in a confirmed report, claiming ChatGPT advised an epilepsy patient to stop taking seizure medication.
Confirmed by Cult of Mac: ChatGPT now connects to iCloud Mail and Calendar for seamless email and event management.
Confirmed per Asia Business Outlook: China's CXMT is starting artificial intelligence memory production despite low yields.
Reported by EdTech Innovation Hub: The UK launched an artificial intelligence Biosecurity Lab with backing from OpenAI and Anthropic.
India's defence ministry has partnered with Sarvam AI to build a unified, secure artificial intelligence system for all military branches, confirmed by TradeFlock.
Free every hour.
